description: Universal AIoT platform — canonical device protocol, virtual device simulator, backend (REST API + embedded MQTT broker + realtime WebSocket + automation engine), and React dashboard, all on one MQTT protocol (aiot/v1 topics). Virtual mode is the default testing mode: no physical ESP32 hardware required.
name: universal-aiot

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@aiot/contracts && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
